notes: Reviewed all 8 European/Eurasian profiles and all 17 unique referenced record ids. Every reference exists and own heading/scope topic was reread; 5 records have summary/template/link bodies.

All 16 unique authority URLs and all referenced source URLs are included in the shared policy-blocked curl audit. No further source retries performed after instruction to finish from body evidence. A policy denial is not a dead-link finding.

EU own-body support checked: 2018/858 scope, manufacturer serious-risk reporting Article 14(2), UN-equivalence Article 58, small-series Articles 41/42 and CoP Annex IV; 2019/2144 Article 4(2), Annex I/II, ADDW E3 category C and head impact B2 category C, direct vision B9 category D; 2021/535 manufacturer plate and VIN subject; Euro 7 Article 21 dates and small-volume exceptions; Battery Regulation Article 77 passport 18 Feb 2027; UN R155 7.3.1 CSMS certificate and R156 section 6 SUMS certificate. Full technical annexes were not audited line by line.

EU Euro 7 finding changes only M1/N1 category wording and explicit small-volume timing. Euro 6e and later CO2 amendments/proposal claims in the same field are carried through unchanged and remain unverified.

The UN R0, R155 and R156 records establish technical topics for GB profile links, but they cannot establish GB recognition/approval procedures or mandatory adoption dates. TR MARTOY and EAEU national records are templates, not legal instruments.
Non-government source explicitly held: ERA-GLONASS industrial union URL. No correction proposal rests on that source.
